title: Twig to Titan
author: SquareWolfGames
selftext:
I just released Twig to Titan on [itch.io](http://itch.io), a fun little game idea I had as a Dragon Ball fan: you start as a twig and power up until you're a titan.



I built it with Claude. It was great for getting a first playable prototype fast. Then I used /goal to take it from prototype to something "releasable", and after that it took about 10 more prompts to fix the balance and squash some bugs.



My main takeaway is that the AI gets you to a working game surprisingly quickly, but the balancing and polish still need your own judgment on what feels fun. Id like to keep polishing the game but I don't have the time and I have better projects to work on.



I can answer question, but if you simply wanna grab the game and play it go ahead!



[https://incognito-patate.itch.io/twig-to-titan](https://incognito-patate.itch.io/twig-to-titan)
